text: Crispy roast potatoes 🥔 Preheat the oven to 220C. Parboil the potatoes for 8 minutes, drain and shake them in the pan to rough up the edges. Tip into a tray of hot oil and roast for 45 minutes, turning halfway. Salt them the moment they come out. #potatoes #sidedish #sundayroast
